patterns.evidence: team_id holds only the ObjectId of the owning team in the teams collection; no team attribute such as its name or on-call email is copied into the host.
host_id holds only the ObjectId of a document in hosts; hostname, datacenter and other host attributes are not copied into the metric document.

Each document groups up to six time-ordered readings (ts, value) of one metric for one host over a one-hour window, bounded by start and end, with count equal to the number of samples (for example a window starting at 14:00 with 6 samples taken every 10 minutes).
